root_cause_label: Forward-Fill Used Instead of Linear Interpolation
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented forward-fill instead of the required linear interpolation for missing water-level values, producing wrong filled values, and then stopped without issuing any task-completion signal.
t_err_evidence: create a Python script to handle the data processing: File created successfully at: /app/process_water_data.py
t_commit_evidence: Once the script is written in step 6 and executed in step 7 the wrong interpolated values are baked into the output CSVs and flood_summary.json; the agent never questions or rewrites the interpolation logic in any subsequent step.
t_surface_evidence: 2024-01-01 00:00,2.3 (leading missing value backfilled with next value rather than interpolated)
trigger_explanation: The agent's plan was correct (fill missing values then detect flood events) but the generated code used pandas forward-fill (ffill) instead of linear interpolation. This is a code-generation quality failure: the model produced syntactically valid but algorithmically wrong code without any ambiguity in the task specification.
